lines.text: The singer lifts his eyes to the LORD enthroned in heaven, as servants watch their master's hand.
The singer asks for mercy because his people have endured much hunger from the arrogant and the proud.
David says that if the LORD had not been on their side, angry men would have swallowed them alive.
The raging waters would have swept them away, but the LORD has not given them as prey to their swords.
Israel escaped like a bird from the fowler's snare, and their help is in the name of the LORD.
